decisions.reason: 다고 했다 is proverbial they-say, not the Sword Saint speaking; scenery matches 풍경.
Preserves the repeated 고마워서; That’s all is unsupported.
Restores 성심성의껏 as wholeheartedly, which devoted omits.
Naturalizes 갈 길 잃은 without the calqued lost eyes.
Keeps the punchy 애잔하다, 진짜 cadence instead of a flattened gloss.
녀석 plus drool is more spoken and less stiff than saliva stains covering the area.
들으셨습니까 points at the snoring, not at Mujin’s speech.
Matches the chapter’s established 비무 rendering as duel.
아는 만큼 보이는 법 is gnomic present, not a past-tense observation.
씁쓸함 is bitterness; hollow changes the emotion.
멀어지는 뒷모습 is a retreating figure, not a mechanical back recede.
전혀 아니다 denies the stinginess; not me invents a contrast.
Restores 겹경사 as a double blessing; two more is extra specification.
위대한 modifies the ruler; powerful empire is unsupported.
Keeps sentence-final 현실 that BASE drops.
고개도 까딱이지 않고 is a withheld nod; dip his head is unidiomatic.
잡아채 갔다 is a completed snatch; snatched at may miss, and at his waist is added.
decisions.replacement: Temur had always been hot-tempered and reckless. Before Chinggen had time to stop him, his hand snatched the curved saber.

decisions.reason: 앉으라고 했다 repeats the prior command; Sit down loses that insistence.
들릴 듯 말 듯 is barely audible, tighter than barely loud enough to hear.
한 축 is a pillar; major forces adds major and drops the image.
초원을 질타했다 is domination, not merely riding across.
말귀가 어둡다 is slow to catch on, not generically a slow one.
